 Oral Judgment
(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S G PANDIT) Heard learned Senior counsel, Sri.K.Diwakar for learned counsel, Sri.Vijay M Malali for appellant.
2. This appeal is filed under Section 54(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on 08.06.2017.
The valuation slip indicates that the appeal is valued at Rs.233,50,56,043/- and court fee to be paid is assessed at Rs.1,18,82,405/- but on the appeal memo a sum of Rs.400/- was paid.
3. On scrutiny, the Registry has raised objection with regard to the deficit court fee to be paid by the appellant at Rs.1,18,82,405/-.
Subsequently, I.A.No.2/2017 is filed by the appellant seeking for a direction to the respondents to deposit the deficit court fee, which was dismissed on 23.10.2025 as untenable.
4. It is noticed that the amount deposited by the respondents in terms of the judgment and award dated NC: 2025:KHC-D:15229-DB HC-KAR 30.04.2016 in LAC No.200/2010 was withdrawn by the appellant.
Even after withdrawing the amount, the appellant has not come forward to deposit the court fee.
5. Learned Senior counsel, Sri.K.Diwakar appearing on behalf of learned counsel, Sri.Vijay M Malali sought further time to deposit the deficit court fee.
There is no justification to grant further time.
The appeal is pending for the last eight years. In the above circumstances, the appeal stands dismissed.

Sd/-
(S G PANDIT) JUDGE Sd/-
